acceptanceCriteria.title: Platform contract exists
evidence: Runtime operations include dictation.native_status, dictation.ensure_native_permissions, dictation.native_audio_ping.
App index has platform module dispatch with macOS source.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Windows is wrapped, not rewritten
evidence: Existing Windows dictation win_hook path remains platform-gated.
No deep Windows internals refactor in this phase.

acceptanceCriteria.title: macOS app search works
evidence: cargo test -p kepler-backend app_index::platform::macos passed.
Runtime smoke discovered 220 apps from mac_applications.
WebSocket app_index.search returned Calculator and Safari-related macOS bundle results.

acceptanceCriteria.title: macOS app launch works
evidence: Runtime smoke launched /System/Applications/Calculator.app through app_index.launch.
Backend returned { ok: true }.

acceptanceCriteria.title: macOS native helpers are integrated as runtime-managed executors
evidence: Swift helper sources exist under platform/runtime/native/macos.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop build:native:macos passed.
Packaged app smoke resolved helpers from Contents/Resources/native/macos.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Dictation/hotkey MVP path is wired
evidence: Runtime has macOS permission checks, hotkey bridge, native audio ping, dictation state/config operations, and paste injection.
dictation.native_audio_ping returned pong over backend WebSocket.
audio-capture-smoke.mjs wrote a WAV file through warmup/start/stop/exit.
Microphone and input-monitoring permissions returned granted: true.
All six Swift helpers were available.
Packaged smoke found no leftover hotkey-hold-monitor after lifecycle fix.
gaps: Full spoken record/transcribe/paste flow with API key was not manually verified.
macOS paste injection may require Accessibility/Automation approval.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Electron remains transport/shell
evidence: Electron changes are limited to backend executable resolution and packaging resources/scripts.
Direct Electron smoke observed boot self-check, backend spawn, app index, and ArkClient connection.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Verification passes where local environment allows
evidence: cargo fmt passed.
cargo check --workspace passed.
cargo test -p kepler-backend app_index::platform::macos passed.
cargo test -p kepler-backend dictation::macos_native passed.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop build:native:macos passed.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop typecheck passed.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop build:js:shell passed.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop build:backend passed.
bun run --cwd platform/desktop package:mac passed and built release/Kosmos-0.4.2.dmg.
Native audio capture smoke wrote a WAV file.
Runtime smoke passed for app search, app launch, helper status, permissions, and native audio ping.
Packaged app smoke passed for packaged backend/resource resolution and ArkClient connection.
Process cleanup check found no leftover backend/native helper processes.
gaps: Playwright _electron.launch attach timed out on this macOS run despite direct Electron/package smoke passing.
Full human visual UI interaction was not performed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: ARK write boundary remains intact
evidence: bun run ark:guard:writes passed after final changes.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Evidence is recorded
evidence: evidence.md, evidence.json, and raw smoke outputs recorded.

knownGaps: Full visual/manual UI interaction was not performed through a human-driven launcher window.
Full end-to-end spoken dictation with API key was not verified.
macOS paste injection uses AppleScript/System Events and may require Accessibility/Automation approval.
DMG packaging works locally but is unsigned/not notarized because no valid Developer ID Application identity is installed.
Playwright _electron.launch attach currently times out on this macOS run despite direct Electron/package smoke passing.
build still targets the Windows publish path; macOS local packaging is exposed separately through package:mac.
